messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency SLO breach for service=inference-api region=eu-west1. p95=2.9s (SLO=1.5s), p99=8.4s. PagerDuty triggered to eng-oncall (P1). Metric link: https://telemetry/redwood/slo/inference-api
Jon H: acked the pager. I'm on-call now, investigating :mag_right:
pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by Jon H at 2026-03-17T12:05:10Z
Maria G: seeing a rapid increase in request queue length on batcher-sidecar pods, +300% over 5m. Also a spike in KV cache eviction rate.
Dan L: can we check autoscaler and batcher config? Maybe batching window increased.
Jon H: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get hpa,batcher -o wide` and `redis info`
Maria G: output snippet: `batcher_queue_depth: 1220` from internal metrics, `kv_evictions/s: 450`. No obvious GC spikes on GPUs.
Dan L: try temporarily decreasing max_batch_size and disabling long-polling. Will push a small config change to staging first. Command I'll run: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/configs/batcher -d '{"max_batch_size":64, "max_latency_ms":200}'`
Jon H: re-routed 10% of traffic to fallback model variant (cpu-optimized) as a quick mitigation. Watching latency now.
incident-bot: NOTE: automated fallback applied (10% traffic -> model=vicuna-7b-quant) per routing policy.
Maria G: after reroute: p95 down to 1.8s in 2m, p99 still noisy at ~4.5s. Looks like hot keys causing heavy tail.
Dan L: evict candidate hot keys from KV cache to stop eviction churn: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "hotkey:*" | xargs redis-cli del` — will do with care.
Jon H: do we have customer impact? I see increased latency on some long-form generation customers but no errors. CS-tickets: 2 maybe impacted. Opening incident doc now.
Maria G: started a short-term autoscale bump: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/batcher --replicas=6` (from 3). Confirmed new pods are joining.
Evelyn S: I'm on shift in ~25m, will take handoff if still hot. Ping me with summary please.
Dan L: post-mitigation check: p95=1.4s, p99=2.2s after scale + reroute + batching tweak. Suggest leaving autoscaler override for 30m while we monitor.
Jon H: agreed. Creating follow-up run: reduce traffic reroute after 45m and roll auto-scaler back. Recording runbook steps: 1) keep reroute 10% 2) autoscale override -> replicas=6 3) watch kv_evictions 4) rollback batching change if regression.
Maria G: customer note: outreach queued for 2 customers using longform generation, CS on it. No widespread outage.
Jon H: handing off to Evelyn in 20m. Evelyn @Evelyn S — summary pinned: p95 SLO breach from queue buildup + kv eviction churn; mitigations applied (traffic reroute + scale + batching tweak); p95 recovered; watch window 45m.
Evelyn S: ack — I will take the watch. If p99 > 3s again, escalate to infra and consider full model swap. :thumbsup:
